title: Lead Value Services Consultant
description:
As a Lead Value Services Consultant, you will lead consulting teams in designing, configuring and integrating Basware solutions for customers, and you will own the most complex parts of each implementation. You will turn architectural designs into clear technical deliverables, guide Solution Consultants through delivery, and act as a trusted subject matter expert for customers and colleagues.
  
  
Beyond individual projects, you will help shape how Basware delivers: coaching consultants globally, improving methods, templates and tools, and contributing to Basware's global communities of practice.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution scoping**

* Lead requirements discovery through interviews and group workshops, working with senior customer stakeholders to understand their organizational challenges
* Develop solutions for complex customer needs and guide Solution Consultants through technical implementation
* Lead teams of Solution Consultants toward successful delivery
* Coordinate and estimate development changes for customers

**Solution and interface design**

* Translate architectural designs into technical requirements and project deliverables
* Design complex solutions and interfaces, recommending best practices that optimize business outcomes
* Oversee build, test and deployment of Basware solutions to ensure quality
* Maintain technical documentation and raise documentation standards and tooling

**Delivery and consulting**

* Implement and deliver high-complexity solutions and interfaces
* Show deep command of tools, configuration and environment setup
* Lead adoption of new solution and integration methods
* Coach consultants and customers on efficient use of the solution and best practices
* Present business concepts and solutions clearly to customers

**Quality management**

* Lead implementation and testing of Basware solutions
* Create test plans that reflect international and customer-specific requirements, and ensure compliance with them
* Manage the defect lifecycle: analyze, prioritize and drive resolution

**Technical support**

* Reproduce and troubleshoot complex issues in test and customer environments
* Design and apply the right technical fix
* Guide consultants in analyzing and resolving complex issues

**Customer training**

* Create and deliver high-quality presentations and training events
* Train customers on best practices and technical topics
* Support other consultants in building and delivering training

**Change management**

* Drive adoption and manage customer expectations through change management processes
* Provide domain expertise and scope medium- to high-complexity change requests
* Help consultants build the skills to handle complex change requests

**Community practice**

* Lead contributions to Basware's global communities
* Coach and mentor consultants worldwide
* Improve and maintain knowledge, tools, methodologies, templates and best practices

,
  
  
**Skills And Competences**
**Technical and solution skills**

* Broad knowledge of Basware solutions and how they interact across the Basware Network, Basware Source-to-Pay and Data Services
* Solution architecture and design: turning business requirements into scalable, workable solutions, with proven solution process modelling and flowcharting
* Strong grounding in architecture patterns such as API-first, event-driven and integration architecture
* Extensive delivery experience implementing interfaces, and specifying them using standard methodologies and documentation standards
* Knowledge of integration approaches (APIs, REST/SOAP, file-based, middleware, ETL, messaging), data mappings, SQL and XML
* Advanced knowledge of software development in at least one programming or scripting language
* Hands-on familiarity with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP)
* Ability to run technical demos, proofs of concept and pilots, and to turn business processes into configuration and design documentation

**Consulting And Delivery Skills**

* Advanced consulting skills, including client advisory and discovery: uncovering the real business problem and giving honest recommendations
* Structured problem solving: breaking down ambiguity, finding root causes, comparing options and building a business case
* Delivery ownership: realistic scoping and estimation, risk, change and quality management, and calm escalation handling
* Strong presentation and workshop facilitation skills
* Strong negotiation and influencing skills
* Awareness of implementation approaches, delivery methodologies and typical project risks, as well as competitors and the market

**Leadership and ways of working**

* Proven track record of coordinating and managing groups of consultants, and of coaching and mentoring others in your area of expertise
* Leading workgroups in international projects and global deployments in a multicultural environment
* Working autonomously and managing your own time effectively
* Fluent business English

**Process knowledge**

* World-class expertise in the delivery process
* Practitioner in escalation, suggestion management and defect management processes
* Coach or mentor in go-to-market and product development processes

**Soft Skills**

* Communication: explaining complex ideas simply and adapting your message to executives, technical teams and customers
* Stakeholder management and influence: building trust and aligning different interests without relying on authority
* Leadership and coaching: developing others, giving direct, constructive feedback and setting the tone for the team
* Problem solving under ambiguity: staying structured and calm when requirements are unclear or a project hits trouble
* Ownership and resilience: taking accountability for outcomes and handling pressure and escalations
* Collaboration across sales, product, engineering, support and customer success

**Required Experience**
**Experience, education and preferred qualifications**

* 8+ years in professional services, implementation consulting or solution delivery for enterprise software
* Proven record designing and delivering enterprise-scale solutions, and leading complex, multi-workstream implementations from design through go-live
* Experience working directly with customers and executive stakeholders
* Experience leading or mentoring consultants, formally or as a technical lead

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant discipline such as computer science or IT (or equivalent experience)
* Strong experience in the design, implementation and consulting of business applications

**Preferred**

* Experience in the source-to-pay (S2P) or procure-to-pay (P2P) industry, or a closely related vertical
* Background in SaaS, enterprise software or systems integration, including ERP-adjacent implementations at enterprise scale
* Experience with AI/ML, analytics or automation platforms

Multilingual or multi-region delivery experience

title: new product development
description:
**Company Description**
A.V. Fasteners is a specialized manufacturer providing high-tensile, stainless steel, and custom-engineered fasteners to automotive, construction, and heavy engineering sectors. The company focuses on precision, durability, and performance, ensuring that every product meets demanding industrial standards. From initial design to final build, A.V. Fasteners supports robust, long-lasting connections for complex applications. Team members contribute directly to products that play a critical role in safety, reliability, and structural integrity across diverse industries.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site new product development role based in Rohtak. The role involves leading and supporting the development of new fastener products from concept through prototyping, testing, and commercialization. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting market and technical research, defining product requirements, coordinating with engineering, production, and quality teams, and managing project timelines and documentation. The role also includes collaborating with customers and internal stakeholders to refine designs, improve existing product lines, and ensure that new products meet performance, cost, and compliance targets.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret data, evaluate design options, and solve technical problems.
* Candidates should possess Research and Development (R&D) and Product Development skills to drive innovation, prototype solutions, and bring new fastener products to market.
* Candidates should possess Communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams, present findings, and engage with customers and suppliers.
* Candidates should possess Project Management skills to plan, prioritize, and oversee multiple development projects within deadlines and budgets.
* Relevant qualifications such as a degree or diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical field.
* Experience in fasteners, automotive, construction, or heavy engineering manufacturing environments is beneficial.
* Knowledge of CAD tools, engineering drawings, and basic quality standards and testing procedures is an advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in Rohtak, maintain organized documentation, and adapt to evolving project requirements.

title: Architect/Manager- Electrification
description:
**Electrification System Architect / Product Design Lead**

**Location:**
India

**Experience:**
8-12 Years

**Qualification:**
B.E./M.E. in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, or Mechatronics Engineering

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced Electrification Engineering professional to lead system architecture, product design, and localization initiatives for next-generation automotive electrification products. The role will be responsible for driving technical roadmaps, product development, OEM engagement, and cross-functional collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and drive Electrification System Architecture, including requirements definition, interface management, and subsystem integration.
* Lead product design and development activities for:
* e-Axles/Electric Motors/Inverters/Battery Packs
* Sensors
* Drive localization initiatives, including component development, supplier assessment, and design validation.
* Apply industry standards and customer requirements (JIS, ISO, OEM-specific standards) throughout the product lifecycle.
* Conduct competitive benchmarking, product teardowns, cost-performance analysis, and technology trend studies.
* Lead DFMEA, design reviews, and Design Validation Plan (DVP) activities.
* Interface directly with OEM customers for technical discussions, architecture reviews, and requirement alignment.
* Develop and execute technology roadmaps for future electrification products.
* Mentor and develop engineering teams while enhancing organizational technical capability.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8-12 years of experience in Automotive Electrification.
* Strong experience in System Architecture and Product Design ownership.
* Deep understanding of EV subsystems such as e-Axles, Motors, Inverters, Battery Systems, and Sensors.
* Experience in product development, validation, and localization programs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and OEM customers.

**Preferred Knowledge**

* Functional Safety (ISO 26262)
* Power BI, SQL
* APQP & PPAP Processes
* DFMEA, Design Reviews, and Validation Methodologies
* Benchmarking and Cost Optimization Activities
* Automotive OEM and Tier-1 Supplier Environment

title: Senior Solution Consultant – Global Consulting Hub
description:
**Role Overview**
The Senior Solution Consultant will implement Basware solutions for customers, ensuring compliance with country-specific requirements while delivering seamless AP automation. The role spans design, build, testing, and post-go-live support, requiring advanced implementation expertise, leadership in solution design, and strong customer engagement skills.
  
  
**Compliance Focus**
This role demands a proactive approach to regulatory compliance, ensuring that all configurations, integrations, and workflows meet local statutory requirements such as e-invoicing, e-reporting, and tax mandates. The consultant will act as a trusted advisor, guiding customers through compliance best practices while embedding these requirements into the solution design and delivery process.
  
  
**Design Phase**

* Conduct in-depth analysis of existing integration rules, custom formats, and business processes to identify gaps and optimisation opportunities.
* Lead advanced design workshops with multiple stakeholders, covering Directory, E-Invoicing, E-Reporting, and complex Use Cases.
* Define field-level mapping strategies for AP Automation and Network integrations, ensuring scalability and compliance with multi-country mandates.
* Collaborate with technical teams to design API notification flows, E-Reporting content structures, and integration points for custom requirements.
* Provide recommendations for process improvements and automation enhancements based on best practices.

**Build & SIT (System Integration Testing)**

* Configure complex invoicing structures, endpoints, and entity hierarchies in Network and AP Automation for multi-entity organisations.
* Develop and maintain custom import configuration files, mapping new fields and adapting business rules for advanced scenarios.
* Execute comprehensive end-to-end testing, including regression testing for existing customers, and document findings in detail.
* Implement advanced features such as E-Invoicing lifecycle setup, E-Reporting monitoring dashboards, Directory API integrations, and portal entity registration for global compliance.
* Troubleshoot integration issues across multiple systems and propose technical resolutions.

**UAT (User Acceptance Testing)**

* Design detailed UAT plans, including complex test scenarios for multi-country compliance and high-volume transactions.
* Facilitate UAT workshops, guiding customer teams through validation processes and compliance checks.
* Analyse defects, perform root cause analysis, and develop fixes with clear documentation for audit purposes.
* Ensure traceability of requirements from design to UAT for compliance assurance.

**Move to Production**

* Prepare comprehensive Go-Live readiness plans, including risk assessments and contingency strategies.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth cutover and minimal disruption to business operations.
* Validate compliance configurations before production deployment.

**Hypercare (Post-Go-Live Support)**

* Provide expert-level Hypercare support, addressing complex issues related to compliance, integrations, and performance.
* Monitor system behaviour post-deployment, identify recurring patterns, and implement long-term fixes.
* Document resolutions and share knowledge transfer with customer teams for future self-sufficiency.

,
  
  

* Flexible shift timings\*

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Minimum 4–5 years of implementation experience in ERP/AP automation projects.
* Advanced understanding of Accounts Payable processes and workflows.
* Hands-on experience with system configuration, data mapping, and integration (APIs, SFTP, REST).
* Ability to lead workshops and manage complex testing phases.
* Familiarity with e-invoicing standards and compliance frameworks.
* Strong documentation and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with Basware or similar AP automation platforms.
* Exposure to multi-country implementations with varying compliance mandates.
* Knowledge of digital and custom delivery methodologies.
* Experience with AI tools, frameworks, or applications is considered a strong asset.

We highly value candidates who demonstrate curiosity, a proactive mindset, and a willingness to explore and incorporate AI-driven technologies into their work. We encourage growth in this area and provide opportunities for experimentation and learning.

title: Manufacturing Planning Specialist - Filters
description:
**Create a better future!**
Do you want to make a difference in the world and contribute to a sustainable future? We believe we can develop technology and gain the knowledge to make that difference. We have launched our ambition, Mission Zero – enabling our customers to move towards zero emissions in mining We need your leadership skills, curiosity, and drive for change to fulfil our goal. Together, we enable our customers to produce the materials needed for a better future.
  
  
**Position: Product Specialist / Business Program Specialist**
We are looking for a highly skilled professional to join our Bawal Business & Program Management team as a Product Specialist. The successful candidate will have following responsibilities as an individual contributor.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Single point of contact for Product lines for new product enquiries, commercials, technical discussion, order confirmation, order & delivery management to deliver the overall value to the end customer.
* Work closely with Product Line Managers, Order desk managers, group strategic sourcing, supply chain, engineering & India manufacturing teams to develop the project scope, deliverables, work plan and timing for new projects.
* Regular coordination with business lines for the business development, revenue growth and future planning/forecasting
* Be interface between manufacturing (Production, planning, procurement, quality, logistics) and other cross functional teams (engineering, supply chain and order desk managers) to lead smooth operations and deliveries.
* Analyse, evaluate, and overcome program risks, and produce program reports for management and stakeholders.
* Integrate with manufacturing and SCM team for rationalized make or buy and localization decisions.
* Prepare monthly produced value, order intake, and rolling forecast matrices.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of Experience in project based low volume industrial equipment manufacturing OEM is preferable.
* Strong techno-commercial understanding for successful driving of the projects.
* Strategic thinking on risk management.
* Good communication skills both written & spoken to deal with global and internal cross functional team based in India and overseas.
* A team player with matrix organization experience.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive benefit package including Health Insurance, Personal Accident / Disability, Group Term Life Insurance, Annual health check-up, and voluntary insurance options.
* Time to recharge through 30 days PTO (with up to 10 days carry forward as Earned Leave stock)
* Work-life balance with a flexible work schedule so you can focus on professional and personal priorities.
* Financial support for continuing education
* Employee Assistance Program
* A global network of supportive colleagues and growth opportunities
* We encourage applicants of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply- the more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.
* As an equal opportunity employer, FLSmidth embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply - the more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is. In our commitment to equal opportunity and eliminating bias, we kindly request that you exclude personal information such as age, ethnicity, marital status, number of children, and photographs from your application materials.

FLSmidth is the leading supplier of engineering, equipment and service solutions to customers in the mining and minerals industries – for more information please visit FLSmidth.com/careers
  
  
We offer all employees access to a dedicated recognition platform, empowering you to celebrate achievements, share appreciation and stay connected globally.
